subject: Is it possible to create a formula y ~ Q1+Q2 in QTL2?

messages.author: c628292d91c65498
messages.subject: Is it possible to create a formula y ~ Q1+Q2 in QTL2?
parts:
Please see the code below from qtl

qtl_MS1 <- makeqtl(mapSNP1, what="prob", chr=c(13, 17), pos=c(30.7, 149.3))

my.formula.cim <- y ~ Q1 + Q2

outcim.fitqtl.SNP <- fitqtl(mapSNP1, pheno.col = 2, method="hk", qtl=qtl_MS1,
                        formula=my.formula.cim, get.ests=TRUE)

#REFINE QTL

rqtl.SNP <- refineqtl(mapSNP1, pheno.col = 2, method="hk", qtl=qtl_MS1,formula=my.formula.cim,
                  keeplodprofile = TRUE)
rqtl.SNP

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to create a formula y ~ Q1+Q2 in QTL2?
parts:
No, we have not yet implemented these functions in R/qtl2.

You could fit 2-QTL models by including one as an additive or interactive covariate and then either scanning for a second QTL with scan1() or fitting a particular second position with fit1().

karl
